name: entities
title: world.entities
lead: Live and queued entities, in ascending id. Optional near/radius select a sphere; kind filters by canonical name. near and radius go together. `mob = true` gives the mobs only, `mob = false` the rest.
signature: world.entities(query: { near: Vec3 ?, radius: number ?, kind: string ?, mob: boolean ? }?) → { EntityHandle }

params.name: query
params.type: { near: Vec3 ?, radius: number ?, kind: string ?, mob: boolean ? }

usedIn.quote: for _, it in world.entities { near = vec3(at.x + 0.5, at.y + 1, at.z + 0.5), radius = 1.5 } do
`world.entities`, as well as handles passed to hooks.
entity here: players are in `players`, never in `world.entities`. `game.entities.<kind>`
world.entities { mob = true }    -- every mob in this room, as handles
world.entities { mob = false }   -- every entity that is not a mob
| `id` | the entity id, as `e.id` and `world.entities()` give it |
